name: slim
description: Universal result proxy for Claude Code — compresses large MCP, Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch, Grep and Agent results, pasted prompt data and (opt-in) @-mentioned files by content (JSON, logs, HTML, XML and SVG, Figma REST node trees, browser accessibility snapshots, linter output, path listings, CSV/TSV tables, plain-text windows), guards spill reads, and adds two tools: lookup answers one question about a page, command or file; view compacts a file or a command output (with jq narrowing, media resize and video frames) into a workspace file

attachments.title: Compress @-mentioned files
attachments.description: true compresses @-mentioned data files; keep false on a Claude Team login, whose host skips this hook and says so on every prompt
